transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. I'm Dr. [Name]. Can you tell me what's been bothering you or what brings you in today?

I’m here because… for about a year now, I’ve been trying to get someone to take seriously that parts of my dad’s lab results aren’t right in the chart. Like something’s being changed or held back in the clinic system.

People keep telling me the numbers are fine—doctors, my family—but what’s there doesn’t match what I saw. And it’s just… wearing me down.
Do you believe that someone is intentionally changing or hiding your father's lab results, or is this something you suspect might be a mistake?

I don’t think it’s just a mistake. I know what I saw, and what’s in the chart doesn’t match. It feels like someone is changing it or holding parts back… but everyone keeps telling me it’s fine. That’s why I’m here.
Have you had any other concerns or beliefs that others might not agree with or understand, outside of what you’ve been telling me about your father’s lab results?

No… not really outside of that. It’s mainly this thing with my dad’s labs.

I know people don’t agree with me about it, but I know what I saw. The chart doesn’t match, and it feels like someone in the clinic system is changing something or not showing everything. That’s… that’s the part nobody seems to understand.
Have you ever had any other unusual beliefs that other people might find hard to understand, even if they don’t seem connected to your father’s lab results?

No… I don’t think so. Nothing like that.

It’s really just this thing with my dad’s lab results. I know people keep saying I’m wrong, but the chart doesn’t match what I saw, and I can’t just let that go.
Have you ever had any other beliefs or ideas that you know other people might find strange or hard to believe, even if they aren’t related to your father’s lab results?

No… not really. I know it probably sounds strange to people, but it’s just this.

For the past year I’ve been trying to prove someone in the clinic system is changing or holding back parts of my dad’s lab results. Everyone keeps saying the numbers are fine, but the chart doesn’t match what I saw. It’s… wearing me down.
Have you ever believed something to be true that others strongly disagreed with, even if you didn’t talk about it much or act on it?

Yes… I guess this would be that.

The thing with my dad’s lab results. Everyone keeps telling me I’m wrong, that the numbers are fine, but I know what I saw in the chart. It didn’t match. And I’ve spent… a long time trying to prove someone in the clinic system changed something or left something out. It’s been wearing me down.
